Our Story

Since 1998 our family has baked sourdough in the heart of Halifax, starting with one wood-fired oven and a starter we still feed every morning. Three generations now share the early shifts, the flour-dusted aprons and the pride of a loaf done right.

We use local grain, long fermentation and no shortcuts. Stop by for a warm loaf, a cinnamon knot or simply a chat about bread; the kettle is always on and the door is always open.

We use local grain, long fermentation and no shortcuts. Stop by for a warm loaf, a cinnamon knot or simply a chat about bread; the kettle is always on and the door is always open.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a groom cost?

Prices start at $45 for small breeds and depend on coat type and size; we confirm the price before we begin.

How do I book?

Book online or call us. Weekend slots fill quickly, so please book a week ahead.

Which vaccinations are required?

Rabies and DHPP must be current. Please bring proof on your first visit.

What is the cancellation policy?

Cancel or reschedule at least 24 hours ahead to avoid a $15 late-cancellation fee.

Is there parking?

Yes, free parking is available behind the salon, with a short-stay drop-off spot by the door.

As the days shorten and the first frost approaches, your garden needs a little care to come back strong in spring. A few hours of preparation now protects roots, soil and tools from the hardest months of the year.

In this guide we cover what to cut back and what to leave standing, how to mulch beds, when to plant bulbs and how to store hoses and pots. Follow these steps and you will start next season with healthier plants and fewer surprises.

Welcome to the community garden! We are glad you are here. The tool shed is open from 7 am to 8 pm; please return tools clean and to their hooks, and report anything broken on the shed whiteboard.
